title: Senior Lead Agentic AI Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production, most recently shipping agentic, LLM-backed features end to end. Designs and builds LangGraph multi-agent and RAG applications with evaluation harnesses, tracing and observability, deployed with FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes. Works directly with clients to turn half-formed requirements into working software, and owns what he ships in production. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Project Schedule Risk Assistant
bullets: Built a LangGraph agent for construction project scheduling that reads plans, progress notes and resource data through RAG and tools, flagging delay risks for planners and project managers.
Evaluated agent answers with an LLM-as-judge harness and planner-reviewed test cases, then served it through FastAPI on Docker and Kubernetes with tracing on every run.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Lead Agentic AI Engineer role in your Construction & Engineering team. Over the past year I have shipped agentic, LLM-backed features into production healthcare workflows, from a document-extraction agent to a multi-agent analytics chatbot. What ties my work together is owning systems end to end, from the first design to running them in production.

IFS builds the scheduling, project delivery and workforce software that construction firms rely on to run major programs, where a wrong answer costs real money on site. Building in a forward-deployed way, close to the planners who use the product, is how I work best. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term.

I would bring hands-on agentic engineering in production. At United Health Group I built a lab-extraction agent with Claude and Amazon Textract that handles about 1,800 lab documents. At Viavi I prototyped 15+ AI applications straight from client requirements, and 7 of them reached production or paid work. I would bring that habit of testing ideas with customers into your team.

Outside work, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building for teachers and students has taught me to design for real users and to release carefully. I would welcome a conversation about how I could help lead your team.
